dangerous-eval.message: eval()/exec() executes arbitrary code from its input.
dangerous-eval.fix: Avoid eval/exec on untrusted input; use ast.literal_eval or explicit parsing.

shell-injection.message: A shell command built from input can be hijacked to run extra commands.
shell-injection.fix: Use subprocess.run with an argument list; avoid os.system and shell=True.

unsafe-deserialization.message: pickle.loads on untrusted data can execute arbitrary code.
unsafe-deserialization.fix: Don't unpickle untrusted data; use JSON or another safe format.

weak-random.message: The random module is not cryptographically secure; its output is predictable.
weak-random.fix: Use the secrets module (e.g. secrets.token_hex) for tokens, passwords, or keys.

hardcoded-secret.message: Hardcoded credential assigned directly in source code.
hardcoded-secret.fix: Load secrets from environment variables or a secrets manager; never commit them.

weak-hash.message: MD5 and SHA1 are broken hashes, unsafe for passwords or signatures.
weak-hash.fix: Use SHA-256 or stronger (hashlib.sha256); for passwords use bcrypt or argon2.

unsafe-yaml-load.message: yaml.load without a safe loader can execute arbitrary code.

insecure-request.fix: Remove verify=False so certificates are validated.
